svg.text: Plate 50 x 60 x 2.5 mm with a stop block 8 x 56 x 6.5 mm standing on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its wrist edge; print plate side down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Block: four 5.2 mm seats 5 mm deep from the wrist face for the sheath

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends, with 1.6 mm tendon holes on through. Seats 24 and 8 mm to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thumb side and 8 and 23 mm to the little-finger side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stitching holes 1.5 mm, 3 mm in from the edge, every 6 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: stitched to the back of the glove over the hand, block toward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the wrist; the four extensor sheaths end in the seats.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a sheath ferrule pushes fully into each seat.
